board-opening.need: A FeltOS enterprise host federates its work board with any number of declared work peers, each with its own presence and shipped ledger.

requirements.says: The host shall accept a set of work peers, each with a presence of continuous or known-intermittent.
The host shall ship each peer what that peer has not received, tracked per peer.
The host shall admit federated work only from a declared peer.
An away known-intermittent peer shall be held while the others still ship.
